messages:
edgecloud-bd: hey team — kicking off a joint POC with AcmeCorp for our copilot integration. they want a shared sandbox, SSO, and a rough cost estimate for a 2-week pilot. can we sync on blockers?

alex: thanks — quick q: is Acme expecting Redwood-hosted sandbox or do they want us to run in their VPC?

edgecloud-bd: they'd prefer a Redwood-hosted sandbox but with network restrictions (ip allowlist) and SAML SSO into their Okta. also they asked for SOC2 evidence and a short security questionnaire.

maria: i can own the SSO flow + cert exchange. if it's Redwood-hosted we can do ip allowlist + API key scoping. need to know which endpoints they'll hit and expected RPS.

sam: for a 2-week pilot, recommend a small dedicated pool (1 x a10g or equivalent) so latency is predictable. pricing estimate: $X/day for reserved pilot capacity vs $Y/day on hosted burst — will confirm numbers.

edgecloud-arch: acme has long context prompts (4k tokens typical) and seq lens up to 8k for reports. will batching/kv cache be okay in the sandbox?

alex: yes — runtime supports continuous KV caching and we can cap max_seq_len. maria, infra-bot: what certs/keys do you need from Acme for SAML?

maria: i'll need their IdP metadata XML (entityID, SSO URL, x509 cert). sample config we attach to them:
```
AssertionConsumerService: https://redwood-inference.example.com/saml/acs
Issuer: https://redwood-inference.example.com/saml/metadata
NameIDFormat: urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress
```
also will require a contact for testing.

infra-bot: note — creating sandbox cluster will take ~48h after req. provisioning window Mon-Fri 9-5 PT.

edgecloud-bd: acme legal also wants a single IP for outbound webhooks and a minimal runbook for incident triage. can we provide that?

sam: yes — we can front webhooks through a proxy and give them a stable egress IP. runbook draft: onboarding -> smoke tests -> fallback to smaller model -> escalation contact. i'll drop a short template in #partnerships-docs.

tina: security questionnaire — pls send to me and i'll pre-fill the infra/ops bits. typical asks: data retention, encryption at rest/in transit, key management, and audit logs. have SOC2 docs ready?

alex: we do. i'll attach SOC2 summary and the cert to the collab folder and ping acme.

edgecloud-arch: last enterprise blocker: Acme asked about on-prem option for PHI workloads. is a private deployment feasible within the 2-week pilot?

maria: not for a 2-week sandbox. we can discuss Private (VPC/on-prem) as a follow-on for a paid engagement. for the pilot, propose a redacted data subset or synthetic data.

edgecloud-bd: understood. next steps: maria to collect SAML metadata and partner contact, sam to send pilot pricing (reserved vs on-demand), tina to start the security questionnaire, alex to share SOC2 and runbook outline. can we aim for provisioning by next Wed?

alex: sounds good — target provisioning request submitted today. i'll cc acme-biz@acme.com on updates. :thumbsup:
